verdict.rationale: Docs describe an iterative build flow with a live 'Preview' used to test the app before publishing (e.g. 'test it in Preview, and publish a live URL'), and publishing is explicitly a separate, later step that creates a production deployment. This confirms founders can interact with a working preview during iteration prior to publish. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on account describing the live-preview interaction experience itself (e.g. responsiveness, real-time updates), and no detail on preview limitations or fidelity versus published app.
